'''Branak''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[free-trader]] from [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. By [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], he often visited [[Kabaira]] where he played [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] with his friends [[Tere Metallo]], [[Menise]], [[Treimar]] and [[Del Hunter]] in [[Drayhar's Cantina]].<ref name="Passages" />
